headline: Demutualization, IDX Opens Door to New Shareholders, Not Just Brokerages
summary: The Indonesia Stock Exchange has formally demutualised, separating share ownership from trading membership. Non-members can now become shareholders.
why: Demutualisation converts an exchange owned by member brokers into a company owned by shareholders, which can change governance and capital access.
original_headline: Demutualisasi, BEI Buka Pintu Pemegang Saham Baru, Tak Cuma Sekuritas
